BiblicalUsage: Mahaneh-dan, the camp of Dan, was the place where the Danites pitched on their way north to Laish, at Kirjath-jearim in Judah, and the name stayed on that ground. It marks the camp where a tribe stopped on its journey to a new home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the camp of Dan is a warning in a name, because a tribe on the move stopped to take what was not theirs, and the camp is remembered for it.
